context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 30 tested the new Calling Feature with WebRTC and PBX integration. Backend APIs tested: Extensions CRUD (list, create, update, delete, get user extension), PBX Configs CRUD (list, create, test connection, update, delete), Call History (get history, missed calls, missed call count), Voicemail (get voicemails, unread count), Recordings (get recordings), Call Status (get/update status), Contacts (get callable contacts), ICE Servers (get servers), Active Calls (get active). Frontend pages tested: Call History page with tabs (History, Voicemail, Recordings), Extensions page with extension cards and create/edit dialog, PBX Settings page with config cards and create/edit dialog, Dialer modal with Contacts and Keypad tabs. All navigation items visible in sidebar under 'CALLING' section.
